explanation: The AI response only listed 5 of the 14 required P600 mountains south of Glasgow (Snowdon - Yr Wyddfa, Scafell Pike, Helvellyn, Skiddaw, and Cross Fell). It missed Goat Fell, Broad Law, Merrick, Carnedd Llewelyn, Glyder Fawr, Aran Fawddwy, Cadair Idris-Penygadair, Waun Fach, and Pen y Fan. Additionally, it incorrectly claimed that these five summits are the only ones.
